input.quote: (e) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5 warrants only legal compliance (knowledge-qualified), rights/authority and non-infringement, plus anti-bribery covenants; there is no warranty that the Services or Works conform to the Specifications or documentation, no warranty period, and no repair/re-perform/refund remedy. Section 1(b) contains a bare professional-and-workmanlike performance covenant but no conformance warranty or remedy, and the implied warranties of merchantability and fitness are disclaimed by §5(e), leaving us with no effective conformance protection. That falls short of even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with the same remedies), so we insert the preferred 90-day conformance warranty with re-performance, repair/replacement or refund and confirm the express warranties survive the disclaimer.

proposal.summary: Add express performance warranty for Services and Works with a 90-day conformance period and repair/re-perform/refund remedy
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 contains no conformance warranty, warranty period or remedy for defective work, so we added a 90-day warranty that the Services and Works conform to the Specifications and documentation with re-performance, repair/replacement or refund as our remedy. This is our standard position for services engagements; we can discuss the length of the period if needed.

ops.text: (f) Contractor represents and warrants that (i) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; and (ii) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each deliverable and Work will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and documentation. Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Contractor's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming deliverable or Work, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverable or Work. The express warranties in this Paragraph 5 are not limited or disclaimed by subparagraph (e) above.
